title: THE OTHER FLY

weight_normalization.description: Compute one structural scale from the maximum absolute row sum observed across both aligned male and female matrices, then divide both matrices by that same scale.

claim_boundary: Engineering smoke only. Verifies graph construction, paired runtime plumbing, deterministic replay, frozen-label resolution, and artifact shape. It is not an SQ-03A scientific result and must not be used for biological interpretation.
